input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: The fee construct meets our preferred position: the Company owes HDI only a 30% revenue share on actual Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold, so all amounts are purely usage/sales-based. The $11,000 figure is a floor below which nothing is payable (a benefit to us), not a minimum spend or take-or-pay obligation, and there is no shortfall, minimum volume or minimum-order language anywhere in the Agreement. Term is one year with automatic one-year renewals terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice (§4.1), plus an immediate termination right if the Site is not live in 70 days (§1.6), so we are never locked into a multi-year commitment. Noted but not flagged here: the §4.2 Termination Payment (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales less $800,000) is an exit cost payable only if we terminate, and the §6.1 exclusivity restricts competing Deerskin web projects — both are termination/exclusivity issues for their own rules rather than minimum purchase commitments, and neither creates a purchase obligation. No redline required.
